notes.title: CONTROLS & STEERING UPDATE
notes.notes:
I read the Steam comments. Thank you for your negative and positive comments. You said in the comments that the controls, namely the turns, were bad. I quickly fixed this. In this update, the car turns much more easily. And some improvements have been made.

Additionally, I added a Crash Point system. Normally if you hit a car at speed you would explode. If you hit it 5 times this time, you will explode. So I made the game a little easier. Also Crash Point is available in the interface.

notes.title: Garage, Training Road & Dyno
notes.notes: Performance customization of the car can now be done with the dyno in the Garage. Performance changes made can be tested on the training path.
